answer.reason: The Chronicles verses on Uzziah (the same king as Azariah) tell his war against the Philistines and his leprosy, which the summary does not say.

clauses.english: warred against the Philistines and broke down the wall of Gath
clauses.quote: warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath

clauses.english: was struck with leprosy as he went to burn incense in the temple
clauses.quote: the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests

doubts: Azariah and Uzziah are treated as one king, as the record's disambiguation and the parallel accounts in 2 Kings 15 and 2 Chronicles 26 indicate.
Verses marked for Zachariah, Menahem, Pekah, Jotham, Ahaz, Isaiah, Hosea, Amos and Zechariah only date those reigns or prophecies by his years, so they were left out.
2CH 26:17 and 26:20 name Azariah the priest, a different man, and were not used.
